sampling: Metrics are evaluated at saved checkpoints; the selected model is shown at the full optimization cost, including validation patience.
continuation: The degenerate-law run warm-starts each larger training set from the preceding stage; aggregate costs and counters include every stage.
residual: R=u-u_old+beta*(f(clip(u,0,1))-a), evaluated on all fixed validation rows. Slope scaling uses R/R_u at the label, with zero assigned when the slope is infinite. Clipping extends the fractional-flow function; network predictions remain unclipped.
scope: Checkpoint metrics describe sampled stages of training; changes between checkpoints are unresolved.
